column1: # Reads of the road-network region grid's constants in the path code (tools/pathpatch's grid input).
# Found by a later scan of every path-related function (holding a node read, a reference to ThePaths, or in the path
# code 0xEF0000..0xF90000) for rip-relative reads of grid floats in any lane: region boxes made from a cell index
# (cell * (512, 512) + (-8192, -8192)) in the node finders and region loops, and the whole-world box of the
# load-every-region call (its last corner an immediate).
# the int16 range (-32768, 32767) a query's y in node units is clamped to before the nodes of a region (sorted by y)
# are searched with cmp word [n+0x1e]: widened (the cmp16 stubs compare 32 bits)
